chunks: And he (peace be upon him) said:

The perfect jurist is he who does not make people lose hope from the mercy of Allah, does not make them despondent of the breath/spirit of Allah, and does not make them feel safe from the deceit of Allah.
ai.seo_question: What are the key qualities of a perfect jurist according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In Shia jurisprudence, this hadith establishes the psychological and spiritual balance of the perfect jurist, ensuring he avoids the extremes of despair (ya's) and false security (ghurur). It highlights that a true scholar must present a holistic view of God, combining hope in His mercy with awe of His power, thereby guiding the community toward a stable and active faith.

en.sayed-ali-raza: 90. Amīr al-mu’minīn, peace be upon him, said:

The perfect jurist of Islam is he who does not let people lose hope from the mercy of Allāh, does not make them despondent of Allāh’s kindness and does not make them feel safe from Allāh’s punishment.
